# Kill The MCP (KTMCP)

> Production-ready command-line interfaces for APIs. We generate CLIs that talk directly to APIs with no servers, no abstraction layers, and no MCP overhead. Currently covering finance APIs with 5 published CLIs.

## Project Overview

Kill The MCP is an open-source project that generates production-ready CLIs for APIs that don't have good command-line tools. We believe CLIs are superior to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for AI agents because they're faster, simpler, cheaper, and more deterministic.

Philosophy: Direct API access beats abstraction layers. No servers to maintain, no protocol parsing overhead, just standard Unix tools that work with any AI assistant.

Current focus: Finance and accounting APIs (Billingo, NOWPayments, Nordigen, Klarna, Codat).

## Available CLIs

- [Billingo CLI](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/billingo): Hungarian invoicing and billing automation API
- [NOWPayments CLI](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/nowpayments): Cryptocurrency payment processing with 200+ coins supported
- [Nordigen CLI](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/nordigen): Open banking across 2500+ European financial institutions
- [Klarna CLI](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/klarna): Buy now, pay later payment integration
- [Codat CLI](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/codat): Unified accounting data from 20+ platforms (Xero, QuickBooks, Sage)

## Installation & Usage

- [npm organization](https://www.npmjs.com/org/ktmcp-cli): All CLIs published as @ktmcp-cli/* packages
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli): Source code for all CLIs

## Documentation

- [Billingo Documentation](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/billingo#readme): Complete API coverage for invoices, clients, products
- [NOWPayments Documentation](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/nowpayments#readme): Payment creation, status tracking, currency management
- [Nordigen Documentation](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/nordigen#readme): Account connections, transaction retrieval, balance queries
- [Klarna Documentation](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/klarna#readme): Payment sessions, order management, captures and refunds
- [Codat Documentation](https://github.com/ktmcp-cli/codat#readme): Company connections, financial data access, unified accounting

## AI Agent Integration

Each CLI includes:

- AGENT.md: Universal AI agent integration guide with usage patterns and examples
- OPENCLAW.md: OpenClaw-specific tool definitions and integration instructions
- Standard input/output: JSON format for programmatic usage
- Exit codes: 0 for success, 1 for errors (easily parseable by agents)
- Environment variable auth: Secure credential management

## Project Resources

- [Main website](https://killthemcp.netlify.app): Landing page with terminal-first design
- [Individual CLI pages](https://killthemcp.netlify.app/billingo): Dedicated pages for each CLI with examples

## Technical Details

All CLIs built with:
- Node.js and Commander.js for consistent CLI structure
- Axios with automatic retry for robust API calls
- Multiple output formats: JSON, table, YAML
- Persistent configuration storage
- Comprehensive error handling with rate limit management

Status: Active development, new CLIs added regularly
